page.layout: One page of text, single column. Page number at head centre. Heading at top centre, then centred question headings alternating with justified italic answers. Decorated initial at the left of the first paragraph. Signature mark at foot right.

p.i: Duplex. Choralis aut Figuralis. Choralis est qui simplicem in suis notulis servat mensuram: Figuralis, qui mensuram, ac notarum quantitatem variat.
Duplex. (Cantus [?] b mollis aut Cantus durus. Cantus b mollis est qui habet b rotundum præfixum: durus qui b rotundo caret.
Clavis est litera , quæ cantum aperit.

page.notes: The initial M is a woodcut letter, transcribed as "MVSICA" with the first word in small capitals. "Die Singekunst" is in black letter. The "(" before "Cantus" in the second answer is uncertain and may be a decorative C. The signature mark at the foot is hard to read and is given as "Z 2" with a doubt marker. No running head, catchword or marginal notes are printed.
